game.blurb: Anime action RPG from Cygames, released 2024-02-01. RAWG has no playtime yet. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); of its Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls and Achievements subpages only "Controls" (about 1,600 characters) and "Table of Contents" exist, so nothing was used. Its categories list 2024 and 2026 and Nintendo Switch 2, and it links a separate page "Granblue Fantasy: Relink - Endless Ragnarok". granblue.fandom.com has a page under this title but it links no articles (granbluefantasy.fandom.com gave the same page), so Fandom gave no structure. RAWG's first result, granblue-fantasy-relink (id 357246), matches; RAWG also has a second entry, granblue-fantasy-relink-2. 38 of 96 Steam achievements are hidden. Twenty of them, from "Endless Ragnarok" onward in the Steam list, sit among the Chaos and Conflux achievements with low unlock rates (1 to 17%), so they are grouped with that endgame chapter by list position and by the "Endless Ragnarok" name; the data does not say they belong to an add-on. The other 18 hidden ones sit in the main story chapter; some ("The Ultimate" at 4%, "Cannon Crusher", "Primeval Dragon" at 5%) are probably optional bosses rather than story steps. Several achievements say "excluding add-on content".
